messages:
Maya Patel: Kicking off a short sync on dashboard / tracing / error-retention tradeoffs for Q3. Main question: do we prioritize extended raw-event retention (90d) or reduce storage & introduce aggregated rollups + deterministic sampling? Need cost numbers, customer asks, and launch criteria.

Dan Kim: We have 2 customers already asking for 90d raw events (AcmeBank, HealthNet). Ballpark: keeping raw events 90d would add ~35% infra spend (storage + query CPU) on our current workloads.

Priya Rao: +1 on tiering. Proposal: default 30d raw, 90d rollups (counts/histograms), 365d metadata index-only. Offer opt-in 90d raw for Enterprise with surcharge. Also want to test prefix/kv caching to reduce query CPU for long tails.

Luke Chen: UX note: settings must be explicit and show incremental cost estimate inline. Suggest a simple tier selector with a compact explainer and a "preview sample" modal. I'll drop Figma mocks later.

Jordan Rivera: For tracing + error analysis we should guarantee deterministic sampling for errored spans so alerts/bug triage remain reliable. Suggested sampling config for POC:```
sampling:
  error_rate: 1.0
  default: 0.05
  high_priority: 0.5
```We also need to ensure alerting rules consider sample window adjustments.

Maya Patel: Important: customer-driven asks we should track — AcmeBank wants 90d raw for compliance, HealthNet needs HIPAA-friendly retention options, RetailCo asked for cheaper analytics queries over long periods. Proposed launch criteria: (1) cost delta <20% vs current for standard tier, (2) restore full raw traces within 72h for Enterprise opt-ins, (3) dashboard query P95 <500ms for standard queries, (4) migration docs & billing flows validated.

Dan Kim: Quick simulation: rollups + sampling gets us ~-18% cost for the standard tier (nice), but query tail latency for ad-hoc queries likely increases. We should run a real workload POC to validate.

Priya Rao: I'll run the workload sim in staging against last quarter's traffic set and produce a cost + latency matrix. ETA: end of week. Test plan link posted to the doc (https://goose.example.com/retention-poc).

Luke Chen: I'll prototype retention-setting UI by Tuesday morning — will include the cost estimator and a compact "what changes" tooltip.

Jordan Rivera: I'll draft a short RFC covering sampling semantics, SLO impacts, and alerting mitigations. Will include a deterministic hashing approach for error traces so we keep reproducible samples.

Maya Patel: Owners: Priya (POC & test plan), Luke (UI), Jordan (SLO/RFC), Dan (cost numbers). I'll own customer comms & launch criteria. Can we sync again in 48h to review POC results? React :thumbsup: if that works.

deploy-bot: Retention-cost-poc job scheduled: job id 20260315-08, queued on staging cluster.

Priya Rao: :thumbsup: added test plan & initial results sheet to the doc. Will ping when the first runs finish.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — will capture action items in the roadmap doc and loop in sales for Enterprise pricing conversations.
